run_flux_inference_spmd: run FLUX image generation inference on TPU using PyTorch/XLA SPMD with model parallel sharding
run_flux_schnell_inference: run FLUX schnell model inference on TPU with reduced 4-step generation and lower latency
profile_flux_inference: profile FLUX inference on TPU using PyTorch/XLA profiler with detached trace collection
shard_transformer_parameters: shard transformer model parameters across TPU chips using SPMD mesh with largest-dimension model parallelism
decode_vae_latents_on_xla: decode VAE latents to images on XLA device by moving VAE to device, decoding, then moving back to CPU
